plan.title: Gender-Based Physical Progress
plan.subtitle: Comparing fitness improvements between boys and girls

panels.title: Total Participants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT "Child ID" FROM baseline UNION ALL SELECT "Child ID" FROM endline)

panels.title: Avg Sit Ups Improvement by Gender
panels.sql: SELECT gender, AVG(end_situps - base_situps) AS avg_improvement FROM (SELECT b."Child ID", b."Gender" AS gender, b."Sit ups" AS base_situps, e."Sit ups" AS end_situps FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Avg Shuttle Run Improvement by Gender
panels.sql: SELECT gender, AVG(base_run - end_run) AS avg_improvement FROM (SELECT b."Child ID", b."Gender" AS gender, b."Shuttle run sec" AS base_run, e."Shuttle run sec" AS end_run FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Gender Performance Summary
panels.sql: SELECT gender, AVG(end_situps - base_situps) AS avg_situp_gain, AVG(base_run - end_run) AS avg_run_gain FROM (SELECT b."Child ID", b."Gender" AS gender, b."Sit ups" AS base_situps, e."Sit ups" AS end_situps, b."Shuttle run sec" AS base_run, e."Shuttle run sec" AS end_run FROM baseline b JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID") GROUP BY 1

plan.narrative:

In terms of core strength, the average sit-up improvement for {{p2.gender}} is {{p2.avg_improvement}}. For speed and stamina, the average shuttle run improvement is {{p3.avg_improvement}} seconds.
